text: Mrs. Blackridge is a human who lives just outside Goldshire. Along with her husband and son, she runs a farm in Elwynn Forest. During her days on the farm, she wished her son would take more responsibility and start doing his jobs on the farm properly. When word reached the Defias Brotherhood that their son was plundering ships, they kidnapped her and her husband. They would eventually be freed and returned to the farm along with their son.

:Aaaaaughibbrgubugbugrguburgle! aka RwlRwlRwlRwl (Blizzard spelling)(MP3 sound) Murlocs (known as gmmmlmrmrgmg or Mmmurlok in their language) are a bipedal, amphibious humanoid race mostly residing along coastlines, lakeshores, and riverbeds. Murlocs tend to dwell in amply-populated coastal settlements, and it is unusual to find individuals wandering too far from their compatriots. According to Brann Bronzebeard, murlocs are smarter than what other races think—smart enough to not let anyone know.

.]] Mur'gul are "normal murlocs" that were seen as creeps and units in Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne. Lady Vashj's naga have enslaved a number of mur'gul, and has used them as both cannon fodder and a labor force. Mur'gul Slaves and Mur'gul Reavers are used by the naga as their most basic units. Some time after the Battle of Mount Hyjal a group of wild mur'gul appeared in Azshara and were encountered by Maiev's group of Watchers. Mur'gul differ from murlocs in that they have larger teeth, armored scales, and spikes on their backs. Some murlocs, but not all, later used the mur'gul model with the spikes (and not their usual fins) and mur'gul likely influenced their current design.

The Mur'gul Slave is a mur'gul unit trained by the naga at the Temple of Tides. Mur'Gul unit enslaved by the naga as resource gatherers and builders. Though very strong physically (they can carry as much wood or gold as an Orc Peon or Human Peasant), the Slaves are rather fragile in combat situations, not having been trained for the arts of war. The Slaves have a religion of sorts, for the Temple of Tides is where they are trained and gather. Insult has been added to injury as the Slaves are jailed not only by Naga, but Reavers as well. Mur'gul slaves are not available on any map, but can be added into them via world editor, thus allowing the player to use the naga line.

Murloc RPG is a fan-made game in which the player plays as a murloc named Murk. Its gameplay involves a side-view camera, turn-based combat, and a number of features borrowed from World of Warcraft such as leveling, NPCs, quests, and zones. Created by "un-mediocre," it was posted to Newgrounds in March 2006. An expansion titled Stranglethorn Fever was released in July 2011, and a sequel titled Murloc RPG 2: Episode 1 followed in September 2011.

Mushan, also called mushan beasts, are reptilian beasts found on Pandaria. They are very similar to the kodo and are used as beasts of burden by many of the races on the land, including the pandaren and yaungol, as well as some saurok. For years pandaren believed these creatures to be untameable. Just ask the first pandaren to do so, Henshi "Limp Along" Homebrew. Some people say that riding an ashhide mushan will result in favorable health and increased prosperity. These people are called "mount vendors."
